title: The Eden Gardens Paradox: Batting Paradise or Tactical Battleground for Kolkata Knight Riders
dek: Eden Gardens averages {{ev:hg-first-home}} in first innings with a run rate of {{ev:hg-rr-home}}. Kolkata Knight Riders have won {{ev:hg-home-win}} at home, proving that spin variation decides outcomes more than pitch reputation.
excerpt: Eden Gardens has been close to the average IPL venue in run rate. Kolkata Knight Riders home record reflects a balanced tactical battleground.

sections.heading: What Makes Eden Gardens Different
body: Across {{ev:hg-home-matches}} matches in the CricField warehouse, Eden Gardens has produced a run rate of {{ev:hg-rr-home}} against {{ev:hg-rr-other}} at other IPL venues, {{ev:hg-six-home}} sixes per match against {{ev:hg-six-other}}, and an average first-innings score of {{ev:hg-first-home}} against {{ev:hg-first-other}}.
Chasing sides have won {{ev:hg-chase-home}} of decided matches there, against {{ev:hg-chase-other}} elsewhere.

sections.heading: Does the Ground Favour the Home Side?
body: Kolkata Knight Riders have won {{ev:hg-home-win}} of their {{ev:hg-home-n}} decided matches at Eden Gardens and {{ev:hg-away-win}} of matches elsewhere. The ninety-five per cent interval around the home figure is {{ev:hg-home-ci}}; a home record at least this far from even would arise by chance with probability {{ev:hg-home-p}}.
On this evidence there is no statistically clear home advantage for KKR.

sections.heading: Turning Conditions Into an Edge
body: A distinctive ground only helps the home side if the squad is built for it in ways visitors cannot copy. Toss winners at Eden Gardens have chosen to bowl first {{ev:hg-toss-field}} of the time, so the toss decision itself is rarely the edge.
The levers are squad composition and preparation: bowlers whose skills suit the surface and batters who know where the scoring areas are.

sections.heading: What a Home-Away Split Hides
body: Away records include neutral venues and seasons played away from home, and home records span eras with very different squads. A matched comparison would be fairer than this raw split.

sections.heading: CricField Verdict: Distinctive Is Not the Same as Decisive
body: Eden Gardens has been close to the average venue, and the record shows no statistically clear home advantage for Kolkata Knight Riders.
A home edge has to be engineered through squad design rather than assumed.
